docker.io/mcp/cloud-run-mcp:latest.overview:
## Cloud Run MCP Server

The cloud-run MCP server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI assistants and agents to interact directly with Google Cloud Run services through a structured, AI-friendly interface. It enables AI-driven workflows to discover services, inspect configurations, deploy revisions, and manage runtime state without switching to the Google Cloud Console or writing custom integration code. This server is well suited for cloud operations, service management, deployment inspection, and DevOps workflows centered on Cloud Run.
